data.one_liner: CLI tool to quickly scaffold authentication flows and in-app purchases in Nylo projects.
data.what_it_does: Scaffold UI provides command-line tools to instantly generate complete authentication flows (Supabase, Laravel, Firebase, or Basic) and subscription or paywall integrations (RevenueCat, Superwall) inside a Nylo project.
use_when: You are building a Nylo project and need to quickly set up authentication.
You want to integrate RevenueCat or Superwall in-app purchase paywalls with minimal manual setup.
avoid_when: You are not using the Nylo framework for your Flutter application.
You prefer writing custom authentication and payment flows from scratch without a CLI scaffolding tool.
strengths: Drastically reduces boilerplate for setting up authentication and IAP in Nylo projects.
Supports multiple popular backends including Supabase, Laravel, and Firebase.
weaknesses: Tied specifically to the Nylo framework ecosystem.
Limited flexibility outside of the pre-templated UI flows provided by the CLI.
data.setup_notes: Requires running CLI commands via terminal. For Superwall or RevenueCat, specific iOS (In-App Purchase capability, iOS 14.0+) and Android (minSdkVersion 26) native prerequisites must be configured.
